'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Middle Eastern crisis (2023–present)|Middle Eastern crisis]]
**[[Gaza war]]
***[[Israeli bombing of the Gaza Strip]]
****At least 28 [[Palestinians]] are killed and 77 more are injured in a series of [[Israel]]i [[airstrike]]s in [[Gaza City]] and [[Khan Yunis]] in the [[Gaza Strip]] after Israel accused [[Hamas]] of firing at Israeli troops. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2025/11/19/live-13-killed-in-israeli-air-attack-on-refugee-camp-in-lebanon?update=4118146 (Al Jazeera)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/israeli-airstrikes-kill-10-palestinians-gaza-rattling-ceasefire-medics-say-2025-11-19/ (Reuters)]
**[[Israel–Hezbollah conflict (2023–present)|Israel–Hezbollah conflict]]
***One person is killed in an Israeli airstrike attack against a vehicle in [[Bint Jbeil]], [[Lebanon]]. Several students are also wounded on a bus passing in the area. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2025/11/19/live-13-killed-in-israeli-air-attack-on-refugee-camp-in-lebanon (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present)|Russo-Ukrainian war]]
**[[Russian attacks on civilians in the Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present)|Russian attacks on civilians in the Russo-Ukrainian war]]
***[[2025 Ternopil apartment strike]]
****Dozens of people are killed in a series of [[Russian Armed Forces|Russian]] missile and [[drone warfare|drone strikes]] across [[Ukraine]], including 31 people killed and more than 100 others injured in a [[ballistic missile]] strike on a nine-story residential building in [[Ternopil]]. Many more remain missing with [[search and rescue]] operations underway. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/explosions-shake-western-ukraine-after-russias-missile-drone-attacks-2025-11-19/ (Reuters)] [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/11/19/children-among-the-36-wounded-in-russias-overnight-attacks-on-ukraine (Al Jazeera)] [https://kyivindependent.com/ukraine-war-latest-update-2025-11-21/ (''The Kyiv Independent'')]
*[[Rojava conflict]]
**Two [[Syrian Armed Forces|Syrian soldiers]] are killed in a [[shootout]] with [[Syrian Democratic Forces]] militants in [[Raqqa]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/two-syrian-soldiers-killed-clashes-with-sdf-ministry-says-2025-11-20/ (Reuters)]
*[[Insurgency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]]
**Twenty-three [[Pakistani Taliban]] militants are killed in two [[Pakistan Army|army]] raids in [[Kurram District]], [[Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]], [[Pakistan]]. [https://apnews.com/article/pakistan-security-forces-killed-militants-afghanistan-a8afa748dcc24bb8d9a793a138baca87 (AP)]
*[[Islamist insurgency in Niger]]
**At least 10 [[Niger Armed Forces]] soldiers are killed in an attack by [[Jama'at Nasr al-Islam wal-Muslimin]] in Garbougna, [[Tillabéri Region]], [[Niger]]. [https://www.msn.com/en-ca/news/world/al-qaeda-linked-terrorists-kill-at-least-10-soldiers-in-niger-sources-say/ar-AA1QOy9l?ocid=winp1taskbar&cvid=6c0519f49fee4ab2e91c004a9fdb13bf&ei=44 (MSN)]
*[[Religious violence in Nigeria]]
**Gunmen target a [[Church (building)|church]] in [[Ekiti, Kwara State|Eruku]], [[Kwara state]], [[Nigeria]], killing two people and [[Kidnapping in Nigeria|kidnapping]] the [[pastor]] and some [[Christianity in Nigeria|worshippers]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/gunmen-attack-church-nigeria-killing-two-kidnapping-others-2025-11-19/ (Reuters)]

'''Arts and culture'''
*[[2025 National Book Awards]]
**At the 76th [[National Book Award]]s, [[Rabih Alameddine]] wins the [[National Book Award for Fiction|Fiction prize]] for his novel ''The True Story of Raja the Gullible (and His Mother)'', while [[Omar El Akkad]] wins the [[National Book Award for Nonfiction|Nonfiction prize]] for his book ''[[One Day, Everyone Will Have Always Been Against This]]'' about the [[Gaza war]]. [https://www.npr.org/2025/11/20/nx-s1-5607997/here-are-the-winners-of-the-2025-national-book-awards (NPR)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*2025 Ōita fire
**One person is killed and another injured in a large-scale fire in [[Ōita (city)|Ōita]], [[Japan]]. At least 170 homes are damaged and another 260 households remain [[power outage|without electricity]]. [https://www.npr.org/2025/11/19/g-s1-98403/fire-japan-oita (NPR)]
*Sixty-four people are missing when a [[barge]] capsizes on the [[Sankuru River]] in [[Kasaï Province]], [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]]. [https://apnews.com/article/congo-boat-capsizing-sankuru-river-99873d3846b68a20960868dad93afd43 (AP)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[Cambodia]]n [[Wildlife of Cambodia|conservation]] groups release two [[Captive breeding|captive-bred]] [[greater adjutant]]s into the [[Siem Pang Wildlife Sanctuary]] for the first time, fitting them with [[GPS tracking unit|GPS trackers]] as part of efforts to restore the species' wild population. [https://www.reuters.com/business/environment/cambodia-releases-rare-captive-bred-storks-conservation-breakthrough-2025-11-20/ (Reuters)]
*A suspected outbreak of [[tuberculosis]] kills ten inmates at a prison in [[Guayaquil]], [[Ecuador]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/suspected-tuberculosis-outbreak-ecuador-prison-kills-10-inmates-2025-11-19/ (Reuters)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Foreign relations of Iran]], [[Foreign relations of the Marshall Islands]]
**[[Iran]] releases a [[Marshall Islands]]-[[Maritime flag|flagged]] [[Tanker (ship)|tanker]] and its 21 crew after seizing it without explanation last Friday in the [[Strait of Hormuz]]. [https://apnews.com/article/iran-marshall-islands-tanker-1c977441551b4e22ae7ec57a434cb392 (AP)]
*[[Russia–United Kingdom relations]]
**[[Russian Navy]] [[spy ship]] [[Russian research vessel Yantar|''Yantar'']] uses lasers to disrupt [[Royal Air Force]] aircraft monitoring the vessel in the [[North Sea]] for the first time. The ship was being followed by a [[Royal Navy]] frigate with [[Boeing P-8 Poseidon|Poseidon P-8]] planes deployed to track its movements. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cx24028k7edo (BBC News)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Epstein Files Transparency Act]]
**[[United States]] [[President of the United States|president]] [[Donald Trump]] enacts a [[Bill (United States Congress)|bill]] ordering the release of [[Jeffrey Epstein client list|more information]] about [[Jeffrey Epstein]]'s case, a day after [[United States Congress|Congress]] passed the bill. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/11/20/trump-says-he-signed-bill-to-release-epstein-files (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Human trafficking in Myanmar]], [[Trafficking of Chinese nationals to scam centers abroad]]
**The [[Tatmadaw]] conducts a raid on the [[scam center]] compound in [[Shwe Kokko]], [[Myawaddy District]], [[Myanmar]], and detains 346 foreigners and confiscates nearly 10,000 mobile devices. [https://apnews.com/article/myanmar-thailand-scam-cybercrime-china-4f218e449b5993b37f20705061766bdf (AP)]
*[[Koldo Case]]
**[[Spain]]'s [[Supreme Court of Spain|Supreme Court]] orders the provisional release of former [[Spanish Socialist Workers' Party|Socialist Party]] official [[Santos Cerdán]], who is under investigation for alleged involvement in a [[Organized crime in Spain|criminal organization]], [[Corruption in Spain|bribery]], and [[influence peddling]] in [[public works]] [[Government contractor|contracting]], stating that the risk of [[evidence tampering]] has been reduced. The court requires him to surrender his [[Spanish passport|passport]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/spanish-court-conditionally-releases-pms-former-ally-jail-2025-11-19/ (Reuters)]
*[[Nord Stream pipelines sabotage]]
**[[Italy]]'s [[Supreme Court of Cassation (Italy)|Supreme Court of Cassation]] approves a [[Ukrainians|Ukrainian]] national's [[extradition]] to [[Germany]], where he faces charges related to alleged involvement in the [[Nord Stream]] [[submarine pipelines|pipelines]] explosions in 2022. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/top-italian-court-approves-handover-ukrainian-nord-stream-suspect-germany-lawyer-2025-11-19/ (Reuters)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[Operation Midas]]
**[[Ukraine]]'s [[Verkhovna Rada]] dismisses [[Ministry of Energy (Ukraine)|energy minister]] [[Svitlana Hrynchuk]] and [[Ministry of Justice (Ukraine)|justice minister]] [[German Galushchenko]] after an anti-[[Corruption in Ukraine|corruption]] investigation into alleged misconduct at the [[State Nuclear Regulatory Inspectorate|state nuclear agency]] implicated them, among other officials. [https://www.reuters.com/world/ukrainian-parliament-sacks-justice-minister-galushchenko-2025-11-19/ (Reuters)]
